summary: Full e2e testing of Estima property decision engine. All 22 backend tests pass. Frontend flows verified: landing, register, login, properties CRUD, calculators (EMI with chart), AI Advisor (Claude Sonnet 4.5 responding), Compare tab. Overall app is in excellent shape.

minor.issue: Email is lowercased server-side (by design). Test assertion fixed to use .lower(). Not a bug.

ui_bugs.issue: After Sign out click, URL may remain at /app/advisor briefly before redirect (timing). Functionally logout works — user is cleared and ProtectedRoute redirects to /login. navigate('/') in doLogout + ProtectedRoute Navigate to /login creates slight race. Minor.

issues: Console warning: recharts chart width/height = -1 on initial render before Calculate is clicked. No visual impact but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: suppress recharts width/height warning by adding minWidth/minHeight to chart container or using ResponsiveContainer properly
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True is overly permissive. Should use specific origin. LOW risk in preview but HIGH risk in production.
server.py is 684 lines - within acceptable range but could be split by domain (auth, properties, calculators, compare, advisor) for maintainability
Cookie secure=False is correct for preview HTTP but should be True in production HTTPS
Brute-force lockout after 5 failures on login is implemented and tested - good
Admin seed is idempotent (updates hash if password changed) - correct implementation

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all core flows work; minor logout timing non-issue

seed_data_creation: Test properties created and cleaned up during backend tests. Admin Flat Andheri property created under admin account for UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 22 tests all pass covering health, auth (register/login/me/logout/duplicate/wrong-password), properties CRUD with auth guard, all 3 calculators (EMI, rent-vs-buy, investment-compare), compare/score with 2 properties, AI advisor chat (real Claude Sonnet 4.5). Frontend: All 5 pages functional. Properties add/edit/delete works. EMI calculator shows results and chart. AI Advisor responds. Compare needs 2+ properties to unlock scoring. Recharts console warning is cosmetic only.
